clock.reason: day/hour are shared online observations and avoid the R1 seat-1 observation.step telemetry defect

values.OUT_OF_SCOPE: not a crop working-set member, locked, or a non-crop structure
values.EMPTY_ASSIGNED: working-set member with tile is None; includes never planted and post-harvest non-ongoing soil because both require PLANT
values.GROWING: PLANT for which valid HARVEST is false and future scheduled production remains possible
values.HARVEST_READY: PLANT with yield_units > 0 and day - planted_day >= crop.first_yield_day
values.RETIREMENT_DUE: ongoing PLANT after final scheduled production has been harvested: yield_units == 0, max_lifespan_step >= 0, and no future production remains

deliberate_non_values.POST_HARVEST_REPLANT_DUE: redundant with EMPTY_ASSIGNED for non-ongoing crops; transition provenance may be logged but is not needed for dispatch
deliberate_non_values.CARE_DUE: orthogonal to growth/readiness and represented inside crop_decay_risk_window
deliberate_non_values.AT_RISK: too coarse; the structured mechanical causes below retain action and deadline semantics

harvest_ready.definition: tile.kind == 'PLANT' and tile.yield_units > 0 and day - tile.planted_day >= CROPS[tile.crop].first_yield_day

components.action_phases_until_eod_refresh: turnsPerDay - hour, including the current action phase
components.next_lifespan_decay_phase: the first phase >= max(max_lifespan_step, canonical_step) with even offset from max_lifespan_step
components.lifespan_loss_phase_if_no_action: next_lifespan_decay_phase + 2 * (max(1, yield_units) - 1), only after max_lifespan_step is known
components.empty_random_weed_eligible: working_set_member and tile is None at an end-of-day refresh

limits: The hidden random draw and episode seed are not online observations, so empty-tile random WEED has no deterministic time_to_loss.
lifespan_loss_phase_if_no_action is a mechanical no-intervention deadline, not a prediction of what the future policy will do.
A single scalar risk score is rejected because water, lifespan, and empty-tile random hazard have different actions and observability.

working_set_member.reason: distinguishes actionable EMPTY_ASSIGNED from irrelevant empty farm surface

ontology_mapping.crop_care_action_flow: risk conditions define valid WATER, PLANT, HARVEST, and lifecycle-clearance demand
ontology_mapping.crop_harvest_action_flow: HARVEST_READY excludes immature requests and separates ongoing from non-ongoing aftermath
ontology_mapping.crop_care_completion_rate: denominator can be built from explicit tile-day WATER obligations plus readiness/turnover obligations
ontology_mapping.crop_decay_risk_window: promote engine semantics from rule-needed to engine-verified, while retaining empirical validation qualification
ontology_mapping.crop_surface_maintained: count only working-set PLANT states compatible with continued production under a declared maintenance rule
ontology_mapping.maintained_productive_surface: consume the maintained crop component without collapsing crop/pasture breakdown
